title: Graded commutativity of the rational Poincare cup product
statement:
Let $p$ and $\ell$ be distinct primes, let $a\geq1$ be an integer, put $q=p^a$, let $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, and fix an algebraic closure $k$ of $k_0$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $X_0/k_0$ be smooth, proper and geometrically connected of pure dimension $d\geq0$ [def-weil-geometric-hypotheses], and put $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$. Write $\Ql=\mathbf Q_\ell$, and use the rational coefficient objects and cohomology $H^n(X,\Ql)$ of [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology]. Let $\smile$ be the cup product induced by coefficient multiplication, with the proper-support convention specified in [def-weil-poincare-trace-cup]. For all integers $i,j$, all $x\in H^i(X,\Ql)$ and all $y\in H^j(X,\Ql)$, one has, after identifying $H^{j+i}(X,\Ql)$ with $H^{i+j}(X,\Ql)$,
$$y\smile x=(-1)^{ij}x\smile y.$$
